note: Presidio County publishes no zoning layer: its GIS data (via texascountygisdata.com and Presidio CAD) lists parcels, city limits and districts but no zoning. ArcGIS Hub and Online searches for zoning in the county returned nothing queryable. Marfa's zoning map exists only as a scanned PDF/image (cityofmarfa.com/media/3476, a 2023 ordinance packet), and no public zoning service was found for Marfa or the City of Presidio.
